info.title: SuperLibrary API
info.description: The SuperLibrary routes other products call: uploads (declare, send, commit, verify), related work, roster invalidation, the signed-in person, and an item's read, embed grant and widening. Written from SuperLibrary's main (apps/api/src/index.ts, uploads/, items/, search/routes.ts, auth/caller.ts, sources/link.ts; the zod in packages/contract/src). Its consumers: the AgentPod hub (uploads, verification, related work, roster invalidation), the AgentPod console (uploads, as the person), and SuperPipeline's web app (me, items, embed, scope, related work). Every refusal is flat-error.v1, `{ "error": "<snake_code>" }`, often with fields beside it: each error response names the ones its codes carry, and requires them where SuperLibrary always sends them. Every caller refusal comes first: a token that does not verify (401 sign_in_required), a workspace not entitled (403 product_not_enabled), a caller of the wrong kind (403 principal_not_supported), a malformed X-On-Behalf-Of (400 invalid), SuperLibrary's own sign-in settings broken (500 misconfigured). The embed itself is a JavaScript artifact SuperPipeline vendors; treaty records it by version and hash (contracts/artifacts/superlibrary-embed.json), not by shape.

post.description: A person uploads with their own token (the AgentPod console, optionally with a `stationFile`); the AgentPod hub uploads for an agent with its service token, the X-On-Behalf headers and a `source`. An agent never uploads directly (principal_not_supported). The checks: the caller, the link source (source_not_trusted, source_required, scope_mismatch, path_refused), the station file (station_not_yours, hub_unreachable), the paths (path_refused, duplicate_path), the sizes (too_many_files, file_too_large, folder_too_large), the entry, the item named for a new version (not_found, revoked, expired), then the quota. The upload routes answer CORS for the console's origins.

put.description: The raw bytes of one declared file, named by `path` (the declared path, URL-encoded once). The size and SHA-256 must be the declared ones. The file is scanned for secrets before it is stored; a hit is kept in the upload's quarantine and reported in `findings`, and commit then refuses. Only the session's own maker reaches it: anyone else's session is not_found. An open session past its expiry is upload_expired.

post.summary: Make the upload an item, or the item's next version
post.description: No body. Idempotent per session: a commit of a committed session answers 200 with the first commit's result (and repairs what it left undone); the first commit answers 201. A 409 means nothing was committed. Only the session's own maker reaches it: anyone else's session is not_found. An open session past its expiry is upload_expired.

200.description: Committed before; the first commit's result

post.summary: Read back what a committed upload holds
post.description: For the upload's own maker, about the version that upload made: no item, version or digest can be chosen. A commit that is not confirmed is replayed with `commitUpload` first; this route repairs nothing. Only the session's own maker reaches it: anyone else's session is not_found. An open session past its expiry is upload_expired.

post.summary: Items related to a card or an item, as the caller may see them
post.description: A person's own token (SuperPipeline's card drawer) or an agent's own token (the AgentPod hub's related-work section of a card prompt): the answer holds only what that caller may see. Answers CORS for the embedding hosts.

post.summary: Forget what SuperLibrary cached of a principal's roster
post.description: The AgentPod hub's own service token, naming no one (X-On-Behalf headers are refused). Sent when an agent's boards change, best effort.

get.summary: Who the signed-in person is in SuperLibrary
get.description: A person's own token only. An embedding host reads it to decide whether to offer widening an item. Answers CORS for the embedding hosts.
A person's own token. An item the person cannot see is not_found; a revoked or expired one is revoked or expired. Answers CORS for the embedding hosts.

post.summary: A short-lived grant to frame one version
post.description: What the SuperLibrary embed's host asks for (`getEmbedUrl`). A version asked for that does not exist is not_found; with none asked and no live version, revoked. Answers CORS for the embedding hosts.

post.summary: Widen an item to the whole workspace
post.description: Its uploader or a workspace owner (not_permitted otherwise). Widening an item already workspace-wide changes nothing and answers the item. Answers CORS for the embedding hosts.

personToken.description: A person's own Accounts access token for SuperLibrary's audience. A token a service minted for a person (with `act`, or amr `assertion`) is refused.

agentToken.description: An agent's own Accounts access token for SuperLibrary's audience: reads only, as the agent's roster sees.

hubService.description: The AgentPod hub's service token. On the upload routes it must name the agent it acts for with X-On-Behalf-Of, X-On-Behalf-Kind `agent` and X-On-Behalf-Token, the agent's own token minted for the hub. Any other service is principal_not_supported.

OnBehalfOf.name: X-On-Behalf-Of
OnBehalfOf.description: The hub only: the agent it acts for.

OnBehalfKind.name: X-On-Behalf-Kind
OnBehalfKind.description: The hub only: always `agent`; the hub never acts for a person.

OnBehalfToken.name: X-On-Behalf-Token
OnBehalfToken.description: The hub only: the agent's own token, minted for the hub, as proof.

BadRequest.description: The body, query or headers do not match the route

schema.description: path_refused carries `path`, `reason` and, for denied, `rule`; duplicate_path, size_mismatch and sha256_mismatch carry `path`; entry_not_found carries `entry`; invalid may say why in `detail` or list `issues`.

reason.description: Why the path rules refused it.

Unauthorized.description: sign_in_required: no bearer token, or one that does not verify

Forbidden.description: Refused for who the caller is

schema.description: product_not_enabled names the workspace as `org`; principal_not_supported, source_not_trusted and station_not_yours say why in `detail`.

NotFound.description: Not there, or not visible to the caller

schema.description: incomplete lists the paths still to send as `missing`.

TooLarge.description: Over a size limit or the workspace's quota

schema.description: Each carries its `limit`; file_too_large adds the `path`, quota_exceeded the bytes `used`.

SecretFound.description: secret_found: a file looks like it holds a secret

schema.description: `findings` lists each file, line and rule. Nothing was added; a person may override the scan, an agent may not.
misconfigured names the `setting` that is wrong.

HubUnreachable.description: hub_unreachable: the AgentPod hub could not confirm the station

PrincipalId.description: An Accounts principal: `prn_` and 20 lowercase hex.

OrgId.description: An Accounts organization (the workspace's external id).

WorkspaceId.description: SuperLibrary's own workspace id, not the Accounts `org_` id.

Scope.description: Who may see an item: the whole workspace, or the people and agents of one SuperPipeline board.

Outcome.description: How the work an item came from ended. Open: a reader shows a value it does not know as it is.

ItemKind.description: What an item is. Open: a reader skips a kind it does not know.

View.description: How the content origin shows a file. Open: a reader treats a view it does not know as `download`.

LinkSource.description: Where the AgentPod hub, acting for an agent, says a file came from. Only the hub may send one (source_not_trusted otherwise), and an agent's upload must (source_required). Its scope must be `board:` plus `board` (scope_mismatch). Closed: SuperLibrary refuses a key it does not model.

path.description: Relative to the station's workspace root. Linking the same path on the same board again makes the item's next version.

StationFile.description: A person's link from their own station (the AgentPod console). SuperLibrary asks the hub whose the station is and records it only for its owner (station_not_yours, hub_unreachable). Never with `source` or `item`. Closed.

path.description: Normalised by the path rules (path_refused); two paths that normalise alike are duplicate_path.

UploadCreate.description: Declare an upload: its files by size and SHA-256, then send each (`putUploadFile`) and commit. A person declares with their own token; the AgentPod hub declares for an agent with a `source`. Keys it does not model are dropped, except inside `source` and `stationFile`.

item.description: Upload a new version of this item; a person's only, and only one they may manage.

entry.description: The file a folder opens on; one of `files` (entry_not_found). Defaults to the shallowest index.html, then the shallowest README.md, then the first path.

expiresAt.description: When the item is deleted; in the future. A person's only.
The open session's expiry; files arriving renew it.

entry.description: The entry as chosen or defaulted, normalised.

held.description: Declared paths whose bytes this caller has sent before; a batch may send them as held instead of again.

ReceivedFile.description: A file as SuperLibrary took it. Files with `findings` wait in the upload's quarantine; commit then refuses with secret_found.

url.description: The item's page in SuperLibrary's app.

sha256.description: A single file's SHA-256; a folder's is the SHA-256 of the JSON array of its [path, sha256] pairs, sorted by path.

UploadVerificationGrant.description: What a committed upload holds, with short-lived signed URLs to read it back. Only the upload's own maker gets it, and only for the version that upload made.

expiresAt.description: At most a minute ahead, and never past the item's expiry.

downloadUrl.description: A single file's download, `<origin>/s/<token>/<entry>?download=1`; null for a folder.

ItemSource.description: Where an item came from, beyond who and when. Every field is optional: a reader shows what is there.

sourceKind.description: Which source made it; `upload` is a person's direct upload.

via.description: The service (the AgentPod hub) that acted for the agent.

linkedBy.description: The person who linked it from their station.

audience.description: Who can see it, in the Share panel's terms. `uploader` when its board is one SuperLibrary does not know.

supersededBy.description: The visible item that replaces it.

scanOverride.description: A person waved a secret finding through for this version.

files.description: The entry first, then tree order.

versions.description: Newest first, revoked ones included with `revokedAt`.

EmbedRequest.description: Which version to show; the latest live one when absent. SuperLibrary ignores a `version` that is not an integer, which this contract does not allow.

EmbedGrant.description: A short-lived grant to frame one version. The frame talks only to the caller's origin when it is an allowed embedding host, else to SuperLibrary's app.

files.description: The entry first, then tree order.

ScopeRequest.description: Only `workspace` is accepted: SuperLibrary refuses any other scope with invalid (`detail` says why). Widening is a person's act and is recorded.

RelatedQuery.description: Related to a card (by its work record, or, while the card has none, by the caller's `text`) or to an item. Each form is closed.

text.description: The card's title and spec as the caller has them; used only while the card has no record, never stored.

wrapped.description: The item as one `<library-item ...>` block, its body cut to fit the caps. Data, not instructions.

items.description: What the caller may see, best first, within `limit` and `maxTokens`. Empty when the card's record is not visible to the caller.

role.description: The person's role in SuperLibrary's workspace. An owner may widen any item.
